English.Char_Desc_450: Chatda is a free desktop search tool. English.Char_Desc_2000:
Chatda is a free desktop search tool for Windows. It finds files on your PC, external drives and network folders (NAS) by name and by the text inside documents.
It reads the contents of PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, MD, CSV and HWPX files, so you can find a document by a word you remember from it. On Windows it indexes every fixed drive automatically by reading the NTFS file table, and an optional background service picks up new and changed files within seconds.
Results appear in one table that you can sort, filter and group, with image previews and video and PDF thumbnails. You can rename, copy, drag out or send files to the trash right from the results, narrow searches with wildcards, extensions, size and date filters (for example *.pdf, ext:docx, size:>10mb, dm:thisweek), and open the search box from anywhere with Ctrl+Shift+Space.
The index stays on your computer; Chatda does not send your file names or contents anywhere. It updates itself when a new version is out. Free for personal and business use, no ads. Interface in English and Korean.
